## Indication groups 

```{r}
library(dplyr)
library(tidyverse)
library(ggplot2)
library(visOmopResults)
library(here)

indication_groups <- list(
  rti_ear = "rti_ear",
  rti_other_urti = "rti_other_urti",
  rti_phrayngitis = "rti_phrayngitis",
  rti_sinusitis = "rti_sinusitis",
  rti_lower = c("rti_other_lrti", "rti_pneumonia"),
  chlamydial_infections = "chlamydial_infections",
  sti_other = c("other_sti", "endocervical_infection", "gonoccoccal_infections", "chancroid", "syphilis", "granuloma_inguinale"),
  skin_infection = "skin_infection",
  skin_other = "skin_other",
  uti = "uti",
  gastrointestinal_infections = c("gastroenteritis", "h_pylori", "cholera", "clostridial_infection", "acute_intestinal_amebiasis"),
  rare_infections = c("actinomycosis", "anthrax", "bartonellosis", "brucellosis", "listeriosis", "lyme_disease", "malaria", "plague", "psittacosis", "relapsing_fever", "rickettsial_infections", "trachoma", "tularemia", "vincent_infection", "yaws")
)

group_labels <- c(
  rti_ear = "Ear infections", rti_other_urti = "Other upper respiratory infections",
  rti_phrayngitis = "Pharyngitis", rti_sinusitis = "Sinusitis",
  rti_lower = "Lower respiratory infections", chlamydial_infections = "Chlamydial infections",
  sti_other = "Other sexually transmitted / genital infections",
  skin_infection = "Skin infections", skin_other = "Other skin conditions",
  uti = "Urinary tract infections", gastrointestinal_infections = "Gastrointestinal infections",
  rare_infections = "Rare / other infections"
)

tibble(
  `Indication group` = unname(group_labels[names(indication_groups)]),
  `Individual indication` = map_chr(indication_groups, ~ str_c(.x, collapse = ", "))
) |>
  visTable(type = "flextable")
```



## Table of indication frequencies

```{r}
indicationsTable <- importSummarisedResult(here("Results",  c("table_one_marketscan.csv", "table_one_medicaid.csv"))) |>
  filter(
    variable_name %in% c(
     "Indications [LMP-90, LMP+90]", "Indications [LMP-90, LMP-1]", "Indications [LMP, LMP+90]" 
    )
  ) |>
  mutate(
    cdm_name = factor(cdm_name, c("Medicaid", "MarketScan")),
    variable_name = factor(variable_name, c("Indications [LMP-90, LMP+90]", "Indications [LMP-90, LMP-1]", "Indications [LMP, LMP+90]"), c("[LMP-90, LMP+90]", "[LMP-90, LMP-1]", "[LMP, LMP+90]"))
  ) |>
  arrange(cdm_name, group_level, variable_level, variable_name) 

indicationsTable |>
  visOmopTable(
    type = "flextable",
    estimateName = c(
      "N (%)" = "<count> (<percentage>)",
      "N" = "<count>",
      "Median [Q25 - Q75]" = "<median> [<q25> - <q75>]",
      "Mean (SD)" = "<mean> (<sd>)",
      "Range: Min-Max" = "<min> - <max>"
    ),
    header = c("cdm_name", "exposure"),
    rename = c("Window" = "variable_name", "Indication group" = "variable_level"),
    columnOrder = c("cdm_name", "exposure", "variable_level", "variable_name")
  )
```

# Plots

```{r, fig.height=10, fig.width=7}
indicationsPlot <- indicationsTable |>
  filter(
    variable_name %in% c("[LMP-90, LMP-1]", "[LMP, LMP+90]")
  ) |>
  tidy()

indicationsPlot |>
  ggplot(aes(x = variable_name, y = percentage, color = exposure, fill = exposure)) +
  geom_col(position = "dodge") +
  facet_grid(rows = vars(variable_level), cols = vars(cdm_name), scales = "free")
```
